environment: production Orithos UI with Playwright-intercepted API fixtures
scope: UI-only mocked RFQ detail validation; no supplier, RFQ, receipt, or purchase data was written to Odoo

checks.name: Purchase detail displays RFQ header, line, AUD totals and tax
checks.evidence: Fixture UAT-RFQ-MOCK-001 rendered in the purchase detail dialog.

checks.name: Purchase detail renders internal Odoo approval chatter as plain text
checks.evidence: A mocked internal note containing HTML rendered as text in the Replenishment approval audit section; no HTML was injected into the page.

checks.name: Purchase detail displays the empty incoming receipt state
checks.evidence: Fixture had receiptsAvailable=true and an empty receipts list; the no-incoming-receipts guidance rendered.

checks.name: Purchase confirmation has a second confirmation step
checks.evidence: The RFQ detail opened a separate confirmation dialog; Go back cancelled it. No purchase confirmation POST was observed.

limitations: This validates rendered UI states only, not live Odoo purchase-order or receipt integration.
A real RFQ and supplier record are needed for live detail/receipt integration acceptance.
Do not create a production supplier or RFQ just to satisfy this test.
